description:
Court decisions that EXPLICITLY cite an article ("article 1240 du code civil", "art. L. 1152-1 du code du travail"). Does not find indirect references or citations without an article number: searching by concept is for `search`.

Example: search_decisions_citing(code="CC", num="1240")

code.description: as in get_law_article (abbreviation, name or LEGITEXT)
code.title: Code

limit.description: number of decisions per source (default 20, max 50)
limit.title: Limit

sources.description: optional list of sources to query among ["dila", "jade", "cedh", "cjue"]. Default: all.
sources.title: Sources

name: search_decisions_citing
